d:
ka dashkon se aandolnon aur virodh pradarshanon ka aham kendr raha hai. lekin ab yahan pradarshan nahin ho sakenge. ne iski jagah ramlila maidan, burari graund aur sibidi graund ko nae pradarshan sthalon ke taur par nirdharit kiya hai.
In jaghon ki sthiti janne ke lie hamne tinon jaghon ka jayja liya. koee jagah itni bari hai ki pradarshankariyon ki sankhya vahan nagany si hogi to kahin buking ka kharch aur tarikhon ki kami chunauti hai. burari graund ki duri aur vahan tak pahunchne ka saval bhi pahle uth chuka hai.
